    Lemma 4.6: the endpoint deficit #

    For a string w of positive length over a representation-finite gentle algebra, in which no vertex carries both a top position and a socle position (true for nonsimple bricks by (2.1)), some vertex v satisfies extout_v < socend_v or extin_v < topend_v. Otherwise the extending arrows at the two endpoints close w up into a closed word with all cyclic pairs allowed, which is impossible in finite representation type (not_isRepFinite_of_closed).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.extract_socle_pair {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hSB : D.toPathData.IsSpecialBiserial) (hs : IsString D w) (hn : 0 < w.len) (H : ∀ (v : D.Q.V), w.socend v ≤ w.extout v) (h0 : ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i = some 0) (hl : ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i = some (Fin.last w.len)) :
    ∃ (ρ : D.Q.A) (σ : D.Q.A), w.OutExt 0 ρ ∧ w.OutExt (Fin.last w.len) σ ∧ (D.Q.tgt ρ = w.vtx 0 ∧ D.Q.tgt σ = w.vtx (Fin.last w.len) ∨ D.Q.tgt ρ = w.vtx (Fin.last w.len) ∧ D.Q.tgt σ = w.vtx 0 ∧ w.vtx 0 ≠ w.vtx (Fin.last w.len))

    In the both-socle case, outgoing extending arrows exist at both endpoints with targets x, y or y, x.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.extract_top_pair {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hSB : D.toPathData.IsSpecialBiserial) (hs : IsString D w) (hn : 0 < w.len) (H : ∀ (v : D.Q.V), w.topend v ≤ w.extin v) (h0 : ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (j : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a 0 = some j) (hl : ∃ (a : D.Q.A) (j : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a (Fin.last w.len) = some j) :
    ∃ (ρ : D.Q.A) (σ : D.Q.A), w.InExt 0 ρ ∧ w.InExt (Fin.last w.len) σ ∧ (D.Q.src ρ = w.vtx 0 ∧ D.Q.src σ = w.vtx (Fin.last w.len) ∨ D.Q.src ρ = w.vtx (Fin.last w.len) ∧ D.Q.src σ = w.vtx 0 ∧ w.vtx 0 ≠ w.vtx (Fin.last w.len))

    In the both-top case, incoming extending arrows exist at both endpoints with sources x, y or y, x.

    source

    theorem BrickAccessibility.exists_ext_deficit {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [IsAlgClosed k] [FiniteDimensional k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (hD : D.IsGentle) (hrep : IsRepFinite B) (w : Word D.Q) (hs : Word.IsString D w) (hn : 0 < w.len) (hts : ∀ (p q : Fin (w.len + 1)), (∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p) → (∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a q = none) → w.vtx p ≠ w.vtx q) :
    ∃ (v : D.Q.V), w.extout v < w.socend v ∨ w.extin v < w.topend v
